title: S&P 500 futures gain slightly on AMD's strong earnings as traders await election results: Live updates - CNBC
description: Investors braced for the results of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections.

title: It's Election Day. Control of Congress is on the line, and what else you need to know - NPR
description: Polls closed at 9 p.m. in more than half the country, with the AP calling the Senate race in Georgia for Democrat Jon Ossoff and North Carolina for Roy Cooper.

title: Republican Byron Donalds wins governor’s race in Florida - NPR
description: Donalds, who was backed early by President Trump, will become the state's first Black governor.

title: Miranda Kerr reveals why she refused to return for Victoria's Secret show - USA Today
description: Miranda Kerr set the record straight on declining an offer to appear in the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on the 20th anniversary of her debut.

title: Keisha Lance Bottoms wins the Georgia governor’s race, flipping the office for Democrats - NBC News
description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms has won Georgia’s race for governor, NBC News projects, defeating Republican Rick Jackson and flipping control of the battleground state office for the first time in 24 years.
